package_name: Kangra Lakes & Treks (4D) — Kareri Lake & Triund

itinerary.day_1: Dharamshala → McLeod Ganj (Drive: 10 km · 30 min). Places: McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala. Activities: Tsuglagkhang Temple; Bhagsu Nag waterfall; Tibetan market.
itinerary.day_2: Triund Trek (Drive: Local). Places: Triund. Activities: 9km trek to Triund (2,875m); Dhauladhar snowline views; Overnight camping or return.
itinerary.day_3: Kareri Lake Trek (Drive: 20 km to trailhead). Places: Kareri Lake. Activities: Drive to Ghera village; 14km trek to Kareri Lake (2,950m); Glacial lake overnight.
itinerary.day_4: Kangra Valley (Drive: 40 km circuit). Places: Kangra Fort, Baijnath Temple. Activities: Kangra Fort (3,500+ years); Baijnath Temple; Tea gardens of Palampur.
